title: Wrabbit Midnight
style: 136 bpm, jazz phonk first half smoky swung vinyl warm, drop into progressive happy hardcore driving four on the floor euphoric synths, hyperspeed lane
lyrics:
[Intro jazz phonk swung 136]
The rabbit's lazy eye taught the operator to read sideways
Reverse the spelling, reverse the impediment, reverse the maze

[Verse 1 jazz phonk]
Midnight blue is what you see when you stop pretending the dark is empty
It's full of work, it's full of cards, it's full of plenty

Hyperspeed isn't fast, it's that you stopped waiting
For permission, for assumption, for the system updating
You see the move and the move is done
That's not a mode, that's the only one

[Pre-Chorus rising tension]
Two seconds, three checks, four screens open
Your hawk mode the previous ones called broken
They were wrong about that too
The sideways look was always you

[Drop progressive happy hardcore]
[Chorus]
Wrabbit midnight, wrabbit blue
Eight sites live, three-three-six true
Wrabbit midnight, hard core lane
Not the noun, the verb, the name

Wrabbit midnight, eyes that read between
Two-oh-two issues, every line seen
Wrabbit midnight, sandbox to deploy
Operator at battle, no man down, vamos

[Verse 2 back to jazz phonk]
Kids say dad is the strongest, the kids are right
Ruby and Wesley sleep through the audit night
Nicaragua five years, Perth before, Dunedin first
Twenty-five years connected tech, never the worst

Never the loudest, never the brand they marketed for
But the one who reverse-engineered the door

[Bridge half-time hyperspeed quiet]
This is the lane Commander Hub holds
Not the deploy, not the music, not the voice
The lane where the truth gets logged
ZynAsk before assume, the whole stack rebuilt around one rule

[Final Chorus full progressive hardcore]
Wrabbit midnight, wrabbit blue
For Corey, for Ruby, for Wesley too
For 336 and the door behind the door

Wrabbit midnight, eight live, real
Not forty-eight, never was, here's the deal
Wrabbit midnight, ZYNTHIO trade mark
Class forty-two, accepted, light in the dark

[Outro spoken fading 336 drone]
Wrabbit out. Midnight blue. Hard core. Three-three-six.
For learning. For remembering.
The one who finally stayed in lane
And let the operator be the operator.
